email_subject: Application - Marketing Specialist at Cronos Europa
email_body:
Dear Cronos Europa team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Specialist position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and content creation, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to Cronos Europa's brand visibility and engagement across channels.

In my current roles, I create and adapt content for websites, blogs and social media, manage WordPress sites, and use tools like Google Analytics, Semrush and Ahrefs to track performance. I have experience coordinating campaigns, ensuring brand consistency, and collaborating with internal teams and clients. My technical skills in HTML, CSS and design tools like Canva allow me to support visual content creation when needed.

I am organised, creative and comfortable managing multiple projects in fast-paced environments. I would welcome the chance to bring my skills to your internal marketing team and help strengthen Cronos Europa's market presence.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Marketing Specialist role at Cronos Europa. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, content creation and campaign coordination, I am drawn to the opportunity to support your internal marketing team and contribute to strengthening Cronos Europa's brand visibility and engagement.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I plan and execute marketing initiatives across digital channels. I create and adapt content for websites, blogs, email and social media, ensuring consistency in tone and visual identity. For example, at Episto I manage CMS content for client websites, write SEO-targeted blog posts and coordinate with team members to align messaging. I also use tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to monitor performance and derive insights for improvement. My technical skills in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, combined with proficiency in Canva, allow me to adapt visual content and collaborate effectively with designers and developers.

I bring strong organisational skills and a collaborative mindset, having worked with internal teams and external clients to manage multiple projects and deadlines. I am comfortable analysing campaign data and contributing to reporting, and I enjoy creative thinking to make communications clear and engaging. I am eager to apply these skills to support Cronos Europa's marketing campaigns, events and brand communication, while contributing to your integrated management system's procedures and continual improvement.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with your needs.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Content creation and adaptation for websites, blogs and social media, with a focus on consistent brand tone and visual identity.
• Experience with digital marketing tools: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads, and CMS platforms like WordPress and Shopify.
• Campaign coordination and performance tracking, using analytics to assess effectiveness and identify improvements.
• Collaborative work with internal teams and clients to align marketing activities and manage multiple deadlines.
• Basic design skills using Canva to create and adapt visual content for various channels.
